paite: Noplending in khrist in ahon suaktasakta, huaiziak in dingkip unla, bawi hakkol ah zaw lut nawn kei un.
heading: Khrist A Noplenna
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

paite: Ngai un kei Paul in na kiang ua ka gen, zek na sum uleh Khrist nou a ding in bangmah phattuamna hilou ding ahi.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

paite: Ahi a, dan thu tengteng zui ding a bate ana hi uh chih zeksumte tengteng kiang ah ka theisak nawn ahi.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

paite: Nou dan a siamtan tumte aw, Khrist toh kikhenta na hi ua, hehpihna na puksanta uhi.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

paite: Kou bel Kha ziak in ginna in diktatna lametna ka ngak uhi.
english: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

paite: Khrist Jesu ah zeksum bangmah aphatuam kei a, zeksum louh leng bangmah aphatuam sam kei; itna a sem ginna bel aphatuam hi.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

paite: Hoihtak in na tai uhi. Kua'n thutak zui lou ding a hon dal ahia?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

paite: Hiai khemna zaw nou hon sampa kiang a kipan ahi kei hi.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

paite: Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beupi azelsuak hi.
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

paite: Kei ngaihtuahna bang lou in na ngaihtuah lamdang tuan kei ding uh chih Toupa ah ka hon muang hi; himahleh nou hon hihbuaite, akua akua hita le uh vaihawmna atung ua kia pen athuak ding uh ahi.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

paite: Unaute aw, ke'n zeksum thu gen lailai ka hihleh, bangziak a sawi a om lailai ka hia? Huchibang ahih ngalleh kros kisuihna tuh hihmang ahita ding hi.
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

paite: Nou hon hihbuaite satkhiak in om vanglak le uh ka deih ahi.
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

paite: Nou unaute aw, noplen ding a sap na hi ua; himahleh na noplenna uh sa a ding a lemtanna in zang kei unla, itna in akua akua a ding a kisepsakte hi zaw un.
heading: Kha A Hinna
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

paite: Nangmah na ki-it bang in na vengte na it ding ahi, chih thu kam khat ah dan thu tengteng kimsak in a-om hi.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.” Leviticus 19:18

paite: Himahleh na kikeih ua, na kinektuah uleh na kinekgaihlouhna ding un pilvang un.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

paite: Huchi in hiai ka chi ahi, Kha ah om un, huchi in taksa utna na hihtangtung kei ding uhi.
heading: Kha Pina
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

paite: Sa in Kha adou nak a, Kha in leng sa adou hi; thilhih na tupte uh na hihtheihlouhna ding un huaite akikalh uh ahi.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

paite: Himahleh Kha pi a na om uleh dan nuai ah na om kei uhi.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

paite: Huan sa thilhihte akilangchian hi, huaite hiaite ahi uh: angkawmna, kingaihna, thanghuaina, hukna,
english: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

paite: milim biakna, bumna, huatna, kinakna, hazatna, hehna, kilanna, omtuamna, gintuamna,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

paite: deihgohna, tualthahna, zukhamna, zumun uangtatna, huchibang thilhih chingte'n Pathian lalgam atang kei ding uh chi a tuma a ka hon hilhkholh mah bang in, ka hon hilhkhol ahi.
english: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

paite: Kha gah ahihleh, itna, kipahna, lemna, thuaktheihna, migitna, hoihna, muanhuaina,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith, or, faithfulness

paite: nunnemna, kidektheihnate ahi zaw uhi; huchibang kalh lam in dan himhim a-om kei hi.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

paite: Khrist Jesu a hitate'n sa, alunggulhna leh aduhgawlna toh akilhdenta uhi.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

paite: Kha a hing i hihleh kha mah ah i om ding uhi.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

paite: Kitawngtuah a, kihaza chiat in, i kikoihlian kei ding uhi.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.
